```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(QDNAseq)
  library(Biobase)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(cowplot)
})

bamdir <- "../t2t_bam"

sample_meta <- tribble(
  ~sample,             ~label,    ~display_order, ~color,
  "HT1080-sgCTRL-D0",  "sgCTRL",   1, "#2166AC",
  "HT1080-LOY-D0",     "LOY",      2, "#B2182B"
) %>% arrange(display_order)

samples       <- sample_meta$sample
sample_labels <- setNames(sample_meta$label, sample_meta$sample)
label_colors  <- setNames(sample_meta$color, sample_meta$label)
```

## Pipeline overview

1. Read T2T-CHM13v2.0 100 kb bin annotation (built once via `build_t2t_bins.R`):
   GC content + mappability + difficulty-region overlap per bin.
2. Count reads per bin per sample with `binReadCounts()`.
3. Filter & correct: drop bins flagged `use=FALSE`; fit GC + mappability loess
   correction; median-normalize across genome.
4. Smooth outlier bins, segment with circular-binary-segmentation (CBS),
   then call gain/loss/amplification with `callBins()`.

## 1. Read Counts

```{r run_qdnaseq, cache=TRUE, cache.extra = file.info("../t2t_bins_100kb.rds")$mtime}
# cache.extra above keys cache to bin-file mtime so retunes invalidate
bins <- readRDS("../t2t_bins_100kb.rds")

bam_paths <- file.path(bamdir, paste0(samples, ".bam"))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(bam_paths)))

t0 <- Sys.time()
rc <- binReadCounts(bins, bamfiles = bam_paths, bamnames = samples,
                    isPaired = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
cat("binReadCounts:",
    round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), 1),
    "sec across", length(samples), "BAMs\n")

read_summary <- pData(rc) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = samples),
         label  = factor(sample_labels[as.character(sample)],
                         levels = sample_meta$label))

knitr::kable(read_summary %>%
               select(label, total.reads, used.reads, expected.variance),
             digits = c(0, 0, 0, 4),
             col.names = c("Sample", "Total Reads", "Used Reads",
                           "Expected Variance"),
             caption = "QDNAseq read-count summary")
```

## 2. Raw read counts (vignette `plot(readCounts)` + `highlightFilters`)

Per QDNAseq vignette Section 1.2: raw bin read counts per sample, with bins that **would
be filtered by default QDNAseq settings** (residual outliers + blacklist) shown
in red. We do *not* actually apply these filters — our T2T bin annotation's `use`
column handles this — but the diagnostic shows where default-QDNAseq disagrees
with our custom T2T filter on T2T-aligned data.

```{r vignette_raw_plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=10, fig.show='hold'}
for (s in sampleNames(rc)) {
  plot(rc[, s], logTransform = FALSE, ylim = c(-50, 200), main = s)
  highlightFilters(rc[, s], logTransform = FALSE,
                   residual = TRUE, blacklist = TRUE)
}
```

## 3. GC + mappability correction & segmentation

```{r correct_segment, cache=TRUE, dependson="run_qdnaseq", cache.extra=tools::md5sum("preserve_t2t_bin_mask.R")}
# Drop samples with insufficient depth (safety guard; HT1080 samples are deep)
low_depth <- pData(rc)$total.reads < 5e6
if (any(low_depth)) {
  excluded <- rownames(pData(rc))[low_depth]
  message("Dropping low-depth samples: ", paste(excluded, collapse = ", "))
  rc <- rc[, !low_depth]
}

# Preserve the original T2T eligibility mask (bases >= 60%,
# mappability >= 55%, blacklist < 20%). An all-disabled applyFilters()
# call resets use flags rather than preserving them. Keep X and Y.
source("preserve_t2t_bin_mask.R")
set.seed(20261027) # reproducible CBS segmentation and subsequent normalization
rc_f <- preserve_t2t_bin_mask(rc, bins)
stopifnot(sum(fData(rc_f)$use) == 22682,
          sum(fData(rc_f)$use & fData(rc_f)$chromosome == "Y") == 58)

# Estimate noise / GC + mappability correction (loess)
rc_f <- estimateCorrection(rc_f)

# Correct counts, median-normalize, outlier-smooth
cn_corr   <- correctBins(rc_f)
cn_norm   <- normalizeBins(cn_corr)
cn_smooth <- smoothOutlierBins(cn_norm)

# CBS segmentation (sqrt-transform per vignette: stabilizes Poisson variance)
cn_seg <- segmentBins(cn_smooth, transformFun = "sqrt")
cn_seg <- normalizeSegmentedBins(cn_seg)

# CGHcall sometimes errors with small N; treat calls as optional
calls_ok <- tryCatch({
  cn_called <- callBins(cn_seg)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("callBins() failed (CGHcall internal); continuing without CN calls.\n",
          "  Error: ", conditionMessage(e))
  FALSE
})

# `cn` = most-advanced object available for downstream tabsets/tables
cn <- if (calls_ok) cn_called else cn_seg
stopifnot(identical(fData(cn)$use, fData(rc_f)$use))

cat("Final QDNAseqCopyNumbers object:\n")
print(cn)

# Export for downstream RNAseq integration (analysis_HT1080_extended.Rmd).
# Path is relative to this Rmd's working dir (WGS/code/); resolves to WGS/.
saveRDS(cn, file.path("..", "HT1080_QDNAseq_cn.rds"))
cat("Saved CN object to ../HT1080_QDNAseq_cn.rds\n")
```

## 4. QC diagnostics (vignette `isobarPlot` + `noisePlot`)

**Isobar plot** (vignette Fig. 2): median read counts per bin as a function of
GC content (y) and mappability (x). Used to verify the GC/mappability loess
correction is well-behaved.

```{r vignette_isobar, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, fig.show='hold'}
for (s in sampleNames(rc_f)) {
  isobarPlot(rc_f[, s])
}
```

**Noise plot** (vignette Fig. 3): observed per-bin standard deviation vs read
depth. Theoretical line is Poisson — samples above the line have noisier data
than expected from depth alone (low-quality DNA, mapping issues, etc.).

```{r vignette_noise, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, fig.show='hold'}
for (s in sampleNames(rc_f)) {
  noisePlot(rc_f[, s])
}
```

## 5. Per-sample noise / variance

```{r noise_plot, fig.height=4}
read_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = expected.variance, fill = label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = label_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expected Variance", title = "Per-sample noise estimate") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9))
```

## 6. QDNAseq vignette CN plots {.tabset}

QDNAseq's built-in `plot()` method renders per-sample log2-ratio profiles using
the same conventions as the vignette (Figs. 4–6): grey points = per-bin log2,
orange line = segment means, blue/red bars (only in "called" panel) = gain/loss
probabilities from `CGHcall`.

### After smoothing (vignette Fig. 4)

```{r vignette_plot_smooth, fig.height=4, fig.width=12, fig.show='hold'}
for (s in sampleNames(cn_smooth)) {
  plot(cn_smooth[, s])
}
```

### After segmentation (vignette Fig. 5)

```{r vignette_plot_segmented, fig.height=4, fig.width=12, fig.show='hold'}
for (s in sampleNames(cn_seg)) {
  plot(cn_seg[, s])
}
```

### After calling gains/losses (vignette Fig. 6)

```{r vignette_plot_called, fig.height=4, fig.width=12, fig.show='hold', eval=calls_ok}
for (s in sampleNames(cn_called)) {
  plot(cn_called[, s])
}
```

```{r vignette_plot_called_skipped, eval=!calls_ok, results='asis'}
cat("> `callBins()` did not succeed — skipping `plot(copyNumbersCalled)`.\n")
```

## 7. Genome-wide log2 segmented copy number {.tabset}

```{r extract_segmented, include=FALSE}
fdat <- fData(cn) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "bin_id") %>%
  mutate(chromosome = paste0("chr", chromosome),
         midpoint = (start + end) / 2 / 1e6)

cn_long <- assayDataElement(cn, "copynumber") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("bin_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-bin_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = "copynumber") %>%
  filter(!is.na(copynumber)) %>%
  mutate(log2 = log2(pmax(copynumber, 1e-3)))

seg_long <- assayDataElement(cn, "segmented") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("bin_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-bin_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = "segmented") %>%
  filter(!is.na(segmented)) %>%
  mutate(log2_seg = log2(pmax(segmented, 1e-3)))

cn_df <- cn_long %>%
  left_join(seg_long %>% select(bin_id, sample, log2_seg),
            by = c("bin_id", "sample")) %>%
  inner_join(fdat %>% select(bin_id, chromosome, start, end, midpoint, use),
             by = "bin_id") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(sample_labels[sample], levels = sample_meta$label),
         chromosome = factor(chromosome, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))))

# Genomic x-axis with offsets
chrom_offsets <- cn_df %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(chrom_len = max(midpoint), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(offset = cumsum(lag(chrom_len, default = 0) + 2))

cn_df <- cn_df %>%
  left_join(chrom_offsets %>% select(chromosome, offset), by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(genome_x = midpoint + offset)

# Export tidy long form for downstream RNAseq integration.
saveRDS(cn_df, file.path("..", "HT1080_QDNAseq_cn_df.rds"))
cat("Saved tidy CN long-form to ../HT1080_QDNAseq_cn_df.rds\n")

chrom_labels_df <- cn_df %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(mid = median(genome_x), xmax = max(genome_x) + 1, .groups = "drop")

chrom_bg <- chrom_labels_df %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number(),
         xmin = lag(xmax, default = 0),
         fill = ifelse(idx %% 2 == 0, "grey95", "white"))
```

### Per-sample tracks (faceted)

```{r genome_per_sample, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
ggplot(cn_df) +
  geom_rect(data = chrom_bg,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = genome_x, y = log2), color = "grey50",
             size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(x = genome_x, y = log2_seg, group = chromosome, color = label),
            linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  scale_color_manual(values = label_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chrom_labels_df$mid,
                     labels = gsub("chr", "", chrom_labels_df$chromosome),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "log2 Copy Number Ratio (segmented)",
       title = "Genome-wide log2 copy number — all 8 samples") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
        strip.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"))
```

### All 8 segmented tracks overlaid

```{r genome_overlay, fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
ggplot(cn_df) +
  geom_rect(data = chrom_bg,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(x = genome_x, y = log2_seg, color = label,
                group = interaction(label, chromosome)),
            linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = label_colors, name = "Sample") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chrom_labels_df$mid,
                     labels = gsub("chr", "", chrom_labels_df$chromosome),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "log2 Copy Number Ratio (segmented)",
       title = "Genome-wide log2 copy number — overlay") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
```

```{r chrY_zoom, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
chrY_df <- cn_df %>% filter(chromosome == "chrY")
```

## 8b. chrY zoom with ideogram (sgCTRL / LOY / cytobands + genes)

Stacked layout: sgCTRL on top, LOY in middle, chrY ideogram with cytogenetic
bands, pseudoautosomal regions (PAR1 / PAR2 in cyan), centromere marker, and
five Y-linked genes — **RPS4Y1, ZFY, UTY, KDM5D, EIF1AY** — clustered into two
narrow regions, so labels are staggered vertically to avoid overlap.

T2T-CHM13v2.0 chrY ≈ 62.5 Mb; band positions are approximate (T2T-CHM13 chrY
q12 heterochromatin is substantially larger than hg38).

```{r chrY_ideo_helpers, include=FALSE}
# Shared cytoband stain colors (used by chrY and chr18 ideograms below)
stain_colors <- c(gneg = "white", gpos25 = "grey80", gpos50 = "grey55",
                  gpos75 = "grey30", gpos100 = "black",
                  acen = "#B2182B", gvar = "#4393C3", stalk = "#FED976")

# Authoritative T2T-CHM13v2.0 chrY cytobands (UCSC hs1 cytoBandIdeo track,
# fetched via api.genome.ucsc.edu). chrY total = 62,460,029 bp.
cytobands_chrY <- tribble(
  ~start,    ~end,      ~band,     ~stain,
   0.000000,  0.127375, "p11.32",  "gneg",
   0.127375,  0.454123, "p11.31",  "gpos50",
   0.454123, 10.565750, "p11.2",   "gneg",
  10.565750, 10.724418, "p11.1",   "acen",
  10.724418, 10.883085, "q11.1",   "acen",
  10.883085, 13.307633, "q11.21",  "gneg",
  13.307633, 18.006518, "q11.221", "gpos50",
  18.006518, 20.506564, "q11.222", "gneg",
  20.506564, 25.062557, "q11.223", "gpos50",
  25.062557, 27.449937, "q11.23",  "gneg",
  27.449937, 62.460029, "q12",     "gvar"        # large heterochromatic block
)

# T2T-CHM13v2.0 chrY gene coordinates (UCSC hs1 ncbiRefSeqCurated, Mb).
gene_coords_chrY <- tribble(
  ~gene,    ~start_Mb, ~end_Mb,
  "RPS4Y1",   2.518,    2.544,
  "ZFY",      2.613,    2.660,
  "AMELY",    6.518,    6.526,
  "UTY",     14.141,   14.387,
  "KDM5D",   20.610,   20.651,
  "EIF1AY",  21.451,   21.468
)

make_chrY_panel <- function(sample_label, panel_color) {
  d <- cn_df %>% filter(chromosome == "chrY", label == sample_label)
  ggplot(d) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = gene_coords_chrY,
               aes(xintercept = (start_Mb + end_Mb)/2),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_point(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2), color = "grey55",
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2_seg),
              color = panel_color, linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 62.5), ylim = c(-4, 1), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 ratio", title = sample_label) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 8, b = 0, l = 8))
}

make_chrY_ideogram <- function() {
  # Stagger gene labels into 2 rows so adjacent gene pairs don't overlap:
  #   {RPS4Y1, ZFY}      cluster around 2.85-2.95 Mb
  #   {KDM5D, EIF1AY}    cluster around 19.8-20.6 Mb
  #   UTY                solo at 13.5 Mb
  label_y_lookup <- c(RPS4Y1 = -0.55, ZFY    = -1.00,
                      AMELY  = -0.55,
                      UTY    = -0.55,
                      KDM5D  = -0.55, EIF1AY = -1.00)
  gene_pos <- gene_coords_chrY %>%
    mutate(gene_x  = (start_Mb + end_Mb) / 2,
           label_y = label_y_lookup[gene])

  cen_mid <- cytobands_chrY %>% filter(stain == "acen") %>%
    summarise(x = (min(start) + max(end))/2, .groups = "drop") %>% pull(x)

  # T2T-CHM13v2.0 PAR boundaries (Rhie et al. 2023, Nature)
  par1_xmin <- 0.000000;  par1_xmax <- 2.458320
  par2_xmin <- 62.122809; par2_xmax <- 62.460029

  ggplot() +
    # PAR1 / PAR2 brackets above the ideogram
    annotate("rect", xmin = par1_xmin, xmax = par1_xmax,
             ymin = 1.08, ymax = 1.22,
             fill = "#41B6C4", alpha = 0.7,
             color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2) +
    annotate("text", x = (par1_xmin + par1_xmax)/2, y = 1.42,
             label = "PAR1", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
             color = "#0C2C84") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = par2_xmin, xmax = par2_xmax,
             ymin = 1.08, ymax = 1.22,
             fill = "#41B6C4", alpha = 0.7,
             color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2) +
    annotate("text", x = (par2_xmin + par2_xmax)/2, y = 1.42,
             label = "PAR2", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
             color = "#0C2C84") +
    # Cytobands
    geom_rect(data = cytobands_chrY,
              aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = stain),
              color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stain_colors, guide = "none") +
    # Centromere marker
    annotate("point", x = cen_mid, y = -0.18, shape = 17,
             size = 3, color = "black") +
    annotate("text",  x = cen_mid, y = -0.40, label = "cen",
             size = 3.2, fontface = "italic") +
    # Gene ticks + staggered labels
    geom_segment(data = gene_pos,
                 aes(x = gene_x, xend = gene_x,
                     y = -0.02, yend = label_y + 0.08),
                 color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = gene_pos,
              aes(x = gene_x, y = label_y, label = gene),
              color = "darkblue", size = 3.4, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 63), ylim = c(-1.6, 1.7), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "chrY position (Mb)", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 8, b = 4, l = 8))
}
```

```{r chrY_zoom_ideo, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
plot_grid(
  make_chrY_panel("sgCTRL", label_colors["sgCTRL"]),
  make_chrY_panel("LOY",    label_colors["LOY"]),
  make_chrY_ideogram(),
  ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(2.4, 2.4, 1.6)
)
```

## 8c. chr18 zoom with ideogram

Stacked 3-row layout: sgCTRL on top, LOY in middle, chr18 ideogram with
cytogenetic bands and gene markers (DCC, ST8SIA3, NEDD4L) on the bottom.

NB. DDC (Dopa decarboxylase) is on chr7; the chr18 cancer gene with a similar
name is **DCC** (Deleted in Colorectal Cancer). Plotting DCC here — swap if a
different gene was intended.

```{r chr18_ideo_helpers, include=FALSE}
# Authoritative T2T-CHM13v2.0 chr18 cytobands (UCSC hs1 cytoBandIdeo).
# chr18 total = 80,542,538 bp. T2T re-mapping merges hg38's q24 bands into q23.
cytobands_chr18 <- tribble(
  ~start,    ~end,      ~band,    ~stain,
   0.000000,  3.055502, "p11.32", "gneg",
   3.055502,  7.363114, "p11.31", "gpos50",
   7.363114,  8.663156, "p11.23", "gneg",
   8.663156, 11.062106, "p11.22", "gpos25",
  11.062106, 15.965699, "p11.21", "gneg",
  15.965699, 18.449624, "p11.1",  "acen",
  18.449624, 20.933550, "q11.1",  "acen",
  20.933550, 27.694024, "q11.2",  "gneg",
  27.694024, 35.291319, "q12.1",  "gpos100",
  35.291319, 39.695477, "q12.2",  "gneg",
  39.695477, 46.090953, "q12.3",  "gpos75",
  46.090953, 50.901745, "q21.1",  "gneg",
  50.901745, 56.402692, "q21.2",  "gpos75",
  56.402692, 58.801152, "q21.31", "gneg",
  58.801152, 61.503246, "q21.32", "gpos50",
  61.503246, 64.105093, "q21.33", "gneg",
  64.105093, 69.316653, "q22.1",  "gpos100",
  69.316653, 71.221701, "q22.2",  "gneg",
  71.221701, 75.629292, "q22.3",  "gpos25",
  75.629292, 80.542538, "q23",    "gneg"
)

# T2T-CHM13v2.0 chr18 gene coordinates (UCSC hs1 ncbiRefSeqCurated, Mb).
# Note: DCC spans ~1.2 Mb so we draw it as a wide band rather than a point.
gene_coords <- tribble(
  ~gene,      ~start_Mb, ~end_Mb,
  "DCC",       52.543,   53.739,
  "ST8SIA3",   57.553,   57.570,
  "NEDD4L",    58.244,   58.602
)
# stain_colors is defined in the chrY_ideo_helpers chunk above.

make_chr18_panel <- function(sample_label, panel_color, show_x = FALSE) {
  d <- cn_df %>% filter(chromosome == "chr18", label == sample_label)
  ggplot(d) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = gene_coords,
               aes(xintercept = (start_Mb + end_Mb)/2),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_point(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2), color = "grey55",
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2_seg),
              color = panel_color, linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 80.6), ylim = c(-2, 2), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 ratio", title = sample_label) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = if (show_x) element_text() else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = if (show_x) element_line() else element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 8, b = 0, l = 8))
}

make_chr18_ideogram <- function() {
  # Stagger gene labels vertically so DCC / ST8SIA3 / NEDD4L (clustered within
  # ~7 Mb on q21.33–q22.2) don't overlap.
  label_y_lookup <- c(DCC = -0.55, ST8SIA3 = -1.00, NEDD4L = -0.55)
  gene_pos <- gene_coords %>%
    mutate(gene_x  = (start_Mb + end_Mb) / 2,
           label_y = label_y_lookup[gene])

  # Centromere midpoint = midpoint of the two acen bands
  cen_mid <- cytobands_chr18 %>%
    filter(stain == "acen") %>%
    summarise(x = (min(start) + max(end)) / 2, .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(x)

  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = cytobands_chr18,
              aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = stain),
              color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stain_colors, guide = "none") +
    # Centromere marker: ▲ below the acen bands, with "cen" label
    annotate("point", x = cen_mid, y = -0.18, shape = 17,
             size = 3, color = "black") +
    annotate("text",  x = cen_mid, y = -0.40, label = "cen",
             size = 3.2, fontface = "italic") +
    # Gene ticks + staggered labels
    geom_segment(data = gene_pos,
                 aes(x = gene_x, xend = gene_x,
                     y = -0.02, yend = label_y + 0.08),
                 color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = gene_pos,
              aes(x = gene_x, y = label_y, label = gene),
              color = "darkblue", size = 3.4, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 80.6), ylim = c(-1.6, 1.2), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "chr18 position (Mb)", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 8, b = 4, l = 8))
}
```

```{r chr18_zoom, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
plot_grid(
  make_chr18_panel("sgCTRL", label_colors["sgCTRL"]),
  make_chr18_panel("LOY",    label_colors["LOY"]),
  make_chr18_ideogram(),
  ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(2.4, 2.4, 1.4)
)
```

```{r extra_chrom_helpers, include=FALSE}
make_chrom_panel <- function(chrom, sample_label, panel_color, gene_df) {
  d <- cn_df %>% filter(chromosome == chrom, label == sample_label)
  ggplot(d) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = gene_df,
               aes(xintercept = (start_Mb + end_Mb)/2),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_point(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2), color = "grey55",
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(x = midpoint, y = log2_seg),
              color = panel_color, linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, chrom_size_Mb[[chrom]] + 0.1),
                    ylim = c(-2, 2), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 ratio", title = sample_label) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 8, b = 0, l = 8))
}

make_chrom_ideogram <- function(chrom, cyto_df, gene_df, label_y_lookup) {
  gene_pos <- gene_df %>%
    mutate(gene_x  = (start_Mb + end_Mb) / 2,
           label_y = label_y_lookup[gene])
  cen_mid <- cyto_df %>%
    filter(stain == "acen") %>%
    summarise(x = (min(start) + max(end)) / 2, .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(x)
  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = cyto_df,
              aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = stain),
              color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stain_colors, guide = "none") +
    annotate("point", x = cen_mid, y = -0.18, shape = 17,
             size = 3, color = "black") +
    annotate("text",  x = cen_mid, y = -0.40, label = "cen",
             size = 3.2, fontface = "italic") +
    geom_segment(data = gene_pos,
                 aes(x = gene_x, xend = gene_x,
                     y = -0.02, yend = label_y + 0.08),
                 color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = gene_pos,
              aes(x = gene_x, y = label_y, label = gene),
              color = "darkblue", size = 3.4, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, chrom_size_Mb[[chrom]] + 0.1),
                    ylim = c(-1.6, 1.2), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = paste0(chrom, " position (Mb)"), y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 8, b = 4, l = 8))
}
```

## 9. Copy number calls

```{r calls_table, eval=calls_ok}
calls <- assayDataElement(cn, "calls")  # -2 loss, -1 hetloss, 0 normal, 1 gain, 2 amp
call_summary <- as.data.frame(calls) %>%
  rownames_to_column("bin_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-bin_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = "call") %>%
  inner_join(fdat %>% select(bin_id, chromosome), by = "bin_id") %>%
  group_by(sample, call) %>%
  summarise(n_bins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(call_label = recode(as.character(call),
                             `-2` = "Loss",
                             `-1` = "HetLoss",
                              `0` = "Normal",
                              `1` = "Gain",
                              `2` = "Amp")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample,
              names_from = call_label, values_from = n_bins, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(sample_labels[sample], levels = sample_meta$label)) %>%
  arrange(label) %>%
  select(Sample = label, any_of(c("Loss", "HetLoss", "Normal", "Gain", "Amp")))

knitr::kable(call_summary,
             caption = "Bins per copy-number call category, per sample")
```

```{r chrY_calls_table, eval=calls_ok}
chrY_calls <- as.data.frame(calls) %>%
```

## 10. RNA-seq DEGs vs DNA copy-number drift

Per-chromosome question: is the RNA-seq DEG bias (chr13 up; chr4 / chr6 / chr8
down) driven by underlying CNV/aneuploidy in the LOY clone, or by
transcriptional regulation? Also examined: chr16 and chr22, which show large
DNA losses with comparatively small RNA shifts (candidate **dosage-compensated
/ buffered** chromosomes). We compare the per-chromosome RNA log2FC
distribution (edgeR LOY vs sgCTRL) with the per-chromosome DNA log2 shift
(QDNAseq LOY − sgCTRL).

Logic: if a chromosome is gained at the DNA level, *all* expressed genes on it
should drift up in RNA-seq (not just the DEGs). A bulk RNA shift that matches
the bulk DNA shift implicates CNV; a bulk RNA shift on top of a flat DNA
baseline implicates transcriptional regulation.

```{r de_load_ht1080, include=FALSE}
de_path <- "../../../data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE.csv"
de <- readr::read_csv(de_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(chromosome  = paste0("chr", seqnames),
         gene_mid_bp = as.integer((start + end) / 2)) %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y")))

# Per-bin DNA delta = LOY log2_seg − sgCTRL log2_seg (segmented copy-number).
dna_delta <- cn_df %>%
  select(bin_id, chromosome, start, end, midpoint, label, log2_seg) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = log2_seg) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LOY), !is.na(sgCTRL)) %>%
  mutate(dna_delta = LOY - sgCTRL)

# Map each gene's midpoint to the 100 kb bin that contains it.
de_with_dna <- de %>%
  inner_join(
    dna_delta %>% select(chromosome,
                         bin_start = start, bin_end = end,
                         bin_midpoint = midpoint, dna_delta),
    by = dplyr::join_by(chromosome,
                        between(gene_mid_bp, bin_start, bin_end))
  )

n_de_loaded   <- nrow(de)
n_de_mapped   <- nrow(de_with_dna)
n_de_unmapped <- n_de_loaded - n_de_mapped
```

`r n_de_mapped` of `r n_de_loaded` genes from the DE table map to a usable
QDNAseq bin; `r n_de_unmapped` fall in filtered/blacklisted bins and are
dropped from this analysis.

### 10a. Per-chromosome RNA logFC vs DNA delta — autosome summary

For each autosome: mean RNA log2FC across all expressed genes, mean DNA log2
delta across all bins overlapping those genes, and DEG counts (FDR < 0.05).

```{r chrom_rna_dna_summary}
chrom_summary <- de_with_dna %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% paste0("chr", 1:22)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes        = n(),
    mean_rna_logfc = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rna     = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dna_delta = mean(dna_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_dna     = median(dna_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deg          = sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deg_up       = sum(FDR < 0.05 & logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deg_down     = sum(FDR < 0.05 & logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(chromosome, levels = paste0("chr", 1:22)))

knitr::kable(chrom_summary, digits = 3,
             caption = "Per-chromosome RNA log2FC vs DNA log2 delta (LOY vs sgCTRL). DEG = FDR < 0.05.")
```

```{r chrom_rna_vs_dna_scatter, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
focal <- c("chr4", "chr6", "chr8", "chr13", "chr16", "chr22")
chrom_summary <- chrom_summary %>%
  mutate(focal = chromosome %in% focal,
         chrom_short = sub("chr", "", chromosome))

ggplot(chrom_summary, aes(x = mean_dna_delta, y = mean_rna_logfc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "darkblue",
              linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
              color = "grey50", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = focal), size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = chrom_short, color = focal),
            vjust = -1.0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey55", `TRUE` = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("other autosome", "focal (chr4/6/8/13/16/22)"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Mean DNA log2 delta (LOY − sgCTRL, QDNAseq)",
       y = "Mean RNA log2FC (LOY vs sgCTRL, edgeR)",
       title = "Per-chromosome DNA vs RNA shift",
       subtitle = "Diagonal (dotted) = pure CNV-driven expectation") +
  theme_cowplot()
```

**Interpretation key:**

- Points near the y = x diagonal → bulk RNA shift is explained by bulk DNA shift (CNV-driven).
- Points well above the diagonal (high RNA, flat DNA) → transcriptional upregulation beyond what DNA explains.
- Points well below (flat RNA, gained DNA) → buffering / dosage compensation.

### 10b. Gene-level scatter — focal chromosomes

Every gene plotted: RNA log2FC vs DNA delta of its overlapping bin. DEGs
(FDR < 0.05) in red. Diagonal = perfect CNV match.

```{r focal_gene_scatter, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
ggplot(de_with_dna %>% filter(chromosome %in% focal),
       aes(x = dna_delta, y = logFC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "darkblue",
              linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(color = FDR < 0.05, alpha = FDR < 0.05),
             size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey55", `TRUE` = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("ns", "FDR < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.25, `TRUE` = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, ncol = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.5, 1.5), ylim = c(-4, 4)) +
  labs(x = "DNA log2 delta (LOY − sgCTRL, QDNAseq segmented)",
       y = "RNA log2FC (LOY vs sgCTRL, edgeR)",
       title = "Per-gene DNA vs RNA shift on focal chromosomes",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = 1:1 CNV-explained expectation") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"))
```

### 10c. Statistical test: bulk shift per focal chromosome

For each focal chromosome, two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test asks whether the
RNA log2FC and DNA delta distributions on that chromosome differ from the
distribution on all *other* autosomes. Small p with matched effect direction
on both ⇒ shift plausibly CNV-driven; small p on RNA only ⇒ transcriptional.

```{r focal_wilcox_test}
test_chrom <- function(d, focal_chr) {
  ref_chrs <- setdiff(paste0("chr", 1:22), focal_chr)
  in_chr   <- d$chromosome == focal_chr
  in_ref   <- d$chromosome %in% ref_chrs
  rna_w <- wilcox.test(d$logFC[in_chr],     d$logFC[in_ref])
  dna_w <- wilcox.test(d$dna_delta[in_chr], d$dna_delta[in_ref])
  tibble(
    chromosome  = focal_chr,
    n_genes     = sum(in_chr),
    median_rna  = median(d$logFC[in_chr],     na.rm = TRUE),
    rna_p       = rna_w$p.value,
    median_dna  = median(d$dna_delta[in_chr], na.rm = TRUE),
    dna_p       = dna_w$p.value
  )
}

focal_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(focal, ~ test_chrom(de_with_dna, .x)) %>%
  mutate(rna_p_fmt = format.pval(rna_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300),
         dna_p_fmt = format.pval(dna_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300),
         interpretation = case_when(
           dna_p < 1e-3 & sign(median_rna) == sign(median_dna) ~
             "RNA shift tracks DNA shift — CNV-consistent",
           dna_p > 0.05 & rna_p < 1e-3 ~
             "RNA shift but flat DNA — transcriptional",
           dna_p < 1e-3 & sign(median_rna) != sign(median_dna) ~
             "DNA shifted but RNA opposite — buffered / mixed",
           TRUE ~ "weak signal"
         ))

knitr::kable(focal_tests %>%
               select(chromosome, n_genes, median_rna, rna_p_fmt,
                      median_dna, dna_p_fmt, interpretation),
             digits = 3,
             col.names = c("Chrom", "n genes", "median RNA logFC",
                           "RNA p", "median DNA delta", "DNA p",
                           "interpretation"),
             caption = "Wilcoxon: focal chromosome vs all other autosomes.")
```

### 10d. DEG concordance with DNA direction

Among the FDR-significant DEGs on each focal chromosome, what fraction has a
DNA delta in the same direction? "DNA concordant" = |dna_delta| > 0.1 (≈ ±7%
copy change) and matching sign.

```{r deg_concordance}
deg_concordance <- de_with_dna %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% focal, FDR < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(
    n_deg                = n(),
    n_up                 = sum(logFC > 0),
    n_down               = sum(logFC < 0),
    n_up_DNAgain         = sum(logFC > 0 & dna_delta >  0.1),
    n_down_DNAloss       = sum(logFC < 0 & dna_delta < -0.1),
    pct_up_explained     = ifelse(n_up   > 0, round(100 * n_up_DNAgain   / n_up,   1), NA_real_),
    pct_down_explained   = ifelse(n_down > 0, round(100 * n_down_DNAloss / n_down, 1), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(deg_concordance,
             col.names = c("Chrom", "n DEG", "n up", "n down",
                           "up & DNAgain", "down & DNAloss",
                           "% up CNV-explained", "% down CNV-explained"),
             caption = "Fraction of significant DEGs whose direction matches DNA copy change (|delta| > 0.1).")
```

A high "% explained" (≥ ~50%) on a chromosome means the DEG bias largely
piggybacks on CNV; a low number means the DEGs are mostly transcriptional
on top of a flat DNA backbone.

### 10e. Per-chromosome DEG counts, DNA shift, and top genes

One row per autosome (plus chrX / chrY): number of FDR-significant up/down
DEGs, mean QDNAseq DNA log2 delta (LOY − sgCTRL) across all bins overlapping
expressed genes, and the top-5 most significant up- and down-regulated genes
(ranked by FDR, gene symbol with logFC shown).

```{r per_chrom_deg_table}
top_n_per_dir <- 5  # genes to list per direction

top_genes_chrom <- de_with_dna %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "up", "down"),
         gene_label = sprintf("%s (%.2f)", gene_name, logFC)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, direction) %>%
  arrange(FDR, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_per_dir) %>%
  summarise(genes = paste(gene_label, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = genes,
              values_fill = "—")

# Make sure both columns exist even if some chroms have no up or no down DEGs.
if (!"up"   %in% names(top_genes_chrom)) top_genes_chrom$up   <- "—"
if (!"down" %in% names(top_genes_chrom)) top_genes_chrom$down <- "—"

per_chrom_table <- de_with_dna %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes        = n(),
    n_up           = sum(FDR < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
    n_down         = sum(FDR < 0.05 & logFC < 0),
    mean_dna_delta = round(mean(dna_delta, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median_rna     = round(median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_genes_chrom, by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(up   = ifelse(is.na(up),   "—", up),
         down = ifelse(is.na(down), "—", down)) %>%
  arrange(factor(chromosome,
                 levels = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))))

knitr::kable(
  per_chrom_table %>% select(chromosome, n_genes, n_up, n_down,
                             mean_dna_delta, median_rna, up, down),
  col.names = c("Chrom", "n expressed", "n DEG up", "n DEG down",
                "Mean DNA Δ log2", "Median RNA logFC",
                "Top up DEGs (logFC)", "Top down DEGs (logFC)"),
  caption = paste0("Per-chromosome DEG counts and top ",
                   top_n_per_dir, " up/down genes by FDR. DEG = FDR < 0.05."))
```
